changes.before: If retention becomes CLASS, what does this runtime query report?
changes.after: Make a custom annotation visible while the program runs.

before: @interface declares an annotation type, not an ordinary method-bearing interface. The static nested class Tagged belongs inside Main but needs no enclosing Main instance. An annotation is metadata, not executable behavior by itself. @Retention(RetentionPolicy.RUNTIME) makes this custom marker available to reflection. @Target(ElementType.TYPE) limits it to type declarations.
isAnnotationPresent asks whether Mark is visible on Tagged. No private field access or setAccessible override is needed. Reflection does not make encapsulation or module boundaries disappear.
Expected output or behavior: true. Compiler evidence is recorded separately from app reading completion.
Optional local transfer task: Explain why a marker needs a consumer before it can affect behavior. You may trace it without a JDK; reading completion is not proof of a local run.
after: An annotation is metadata: information attached to code. @interface declares an annotation type. This Mark annotation is allowed on type declarations by @Target. @Retention(RUNTIME) keeps it available while the program runs. The marker does not perform an action by itself.

Reflection lets running code inspect information about classes. isAnnotationPresent checks whether the requested marker is visible on a class. It does not bypass private access or module rules. Tagged is a static class nested inside Main, so it needs no enclosing Main object.
The program prints true. Tagged has the Mark annotation, and RUNTIME retention makes that marker visible to the check.
The quiz changes retention to CLASS. That stores the marker in the compiled class file without making it visible to this check while running.

before.question: If retention becomes CLASS, what does this runtime query report?
choices: true because all annotations are runtime-visible
Compilation always fails for CLASS retention.
before.explanation: CLASS retains metadata in the class file but does not expose it as a runtime annotation to this query.

after.question: Change the retention from RUNTIME to CLASS. What does the query print?
choices: true, because every annotation is visible while running.
Nothing, because CLASS retention always causes a compilation error.
after.explanation: CLASS keeps the metadata in the class file, but this reflection check needs RUNTIME visibility.
